title: Decision: draft-mahy-cbor-pointer-01 is track-only for mimid
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.20 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-cbor-pointer-01.txt (504 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: a CBOR analogue of JSON Pointer: an array of pathspecs, implicit (meaning depends on the parent's type; negative integers count from the end; byte strings are re-read as embedded CBOR) or explicit (each pathspec tagged by expected type), plus array filters (§3). Tags and a simple value are TBD. Informational (L7).

How it meets mimid: none directly. It overlaps the claim pointers of draft-mahy-mimi-credential-preauth-00 (assay mimid-1wgh.44.10), which address CWT claims the same way; if preauth matures it may build on this. mimid has no CWT credentials (sd-cwt decision mimid-1wgh.44.27).

RECOMMEND: track only, alongside credential-preauth.
